# The Weekly AI Edge

> Daan's personal hub: guides from his own setup (a crypto trading bot and an AI agent on a VPS), and research summaries of AI tools with dated prices. Nothing here is financial advice. Last updated 2026-09-26.

Reviews are written by Daan: a Dutch former banker (23 years in international finance) who runs his businesses from Rotterdam, the Netherlands. Most reviews are researched assessments, read from the vendor's own pages and from what other buyers report; where he has run a tool himself, the review says so. His own stack: a Hostinger VPS for his AI agent Victor, which maintains his sites in 35 languages; Replit, where he built a 24/7 crypto trading bot with Replit's AI agent; Bitvavo, the exchange that bot trades on; and Claude.
